modalities.evidence: Heart rate, oxygen consumption, carbon dioxide generation, and pulmonary ventilation are measured on a breath-to-breath basis

output.population: Amateur and professional athletes of ages ranging from 10 to 63 years old
output.summary: Cardiorespiratory measurements from 992 treadmill maximal graded exercise tests, recorded breath-to-breath with treadmill speed, plus participant age, height, weight and test temperature and humidity.
